array.string: set -eu [ ! -d /nix/store ] || exit 0 info=$(/usr/sbin/diskutil info -plist 'Nix Store') uuid=$(printf '%s' "$info" | /usr/bin/plutil -extract VolumeUUID raw -o - -) mountpoint=$(printf '%s' "$info" | /usr/bin/plutil -extract MountPoint raw -o - - || true) [ -z "$mountpoint" ] || /usr/sbin/diskutil unmount "$uuid" password=$(/usr/bin/security find-generic-password -s "$uuid" -w /Library/Keychains/System.keychain || /usr/bin/security find-generic-password -a 'Nix Store' -s 'Nix Store' -w /Library/Keychains/System.keychain) printf '%s' "$password" | /usr/sbin/diskutil apfs unlockVolume "$uuid" -mountpoint /nix -stdinpassphrase
